# parentElement

#### Course: JavaScript in Browser

## parentElement

To access the immediate parent of an element, use the parentElement property.

Suppose we are at the first li item:

![parentElement](data:image/png;base64,)

You can select its parent using parentElement property:

```html
1<div class="container">
2    <h1>Price List</h1>
3    <ul id="price-list">
4        <li class="item">Milk <span>$2.50</span></li>
5        <li class="item">Bread <span>$1.50</span></li>
6        <li class="item">Toothpaste <span>$3.00</span></li>
7    </ul>
8    <button id="update">Update Parent Color</button>
9</div>
```

```javascript
1const listItem = document.querySelector(".item");  
2const update = document.querySelector("#update");
3
4update.addEventListener("click", () => {
5    listItem.parentElement.style.backgroundColor = "#fab802"; 
6});
```
